disposition: Removed; not selectable and not replaced with no-op patches. Originals remain in the uploaded archive.

patches.reason: Unchecked allocation callbacks and incompatible shared TCP metadata; use upstream TCP or explicitly select upstream BBRv1.
Generic memcmp must remain usable without acquiring a SIMD context; retain the upstream integer-register implementation.
Drops sysfs writes and forces a one-second timeout; retain the upstream writable timeout and default.
Wake/abort coalescing is not qualified against this device; retain upstream synchronization.
Shortens suspend-abort wake protection and can convert a negative deadline to an unsigned timeout; retain upstream handling.
A shorter retry timeout has no demonstrated storage-pressure benefit on this device; retain upstream backoff.
This is an in-place-update policy threshold, not a proven fsync batching optimization; retain upstream default and sysfs control.
Actual affinity failures must retain the existing rate-limited warning.
